_meta.description: Final 48-team field, FIFA World Cup 2026. Draw held December 2025; remaining six slots filled by March 2026 playoff winners.
_meta.note: Six teams entered via the March 2026 play-offs (UEFA play-offs + FIFA Play-Off Tournament). By UEFA arithmetic (16 UEFA teams, 12 direct slots) the UEFA playoff winners are Czechia, Bosnia and Herzegovina, Sweden, and Turkiye; Iraq and DR Congo filled the two inter-confederation slots. Exact playoff paths not independently re-verified this session.

format: 12 groups of 4; top two per group plus 8 best third-placed teams advance to a Round of 32 (new for 2026).
